'''Chapter 198''' is titled "4:15 PM".

==Cover Page==
[[Cover Page#Color Spread|Color Spread]]: The [[Straw Hat Pirates]] stop by a tropical lagoon. [[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]], rising late, finds the others already awake and having fun.

==Short Summary==
[[Koza]] has been shot by a fake royal guard, who is actually a member of the [[Baroque Works]]. As a result, the fight between the rebels and the royal army starts. [[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]], unable to stop them and is captured by [[Crocodile]] who is about to kill her. Suddenly hope is coming from the sky with [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] riding on a falcon.

==Long Summary==
As [[Koza]] has been shot by [[Baroque Works]] members disguised as royal army members, a member of the royal army confronts them, not knowing they are spies, and demands to know why they shot Koza. [[Crocodile]] then creates sand in between the royal army and rebel army, obscuring both sides' eyesight. More royal army members are shot, revealing that Baroque Works members infiltrated both sides to make sure they continue fighting. Ignoring [[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]]'s and Koza's pleas to stop fighting, the rebel and royal army engage each other yet again. [[Nico Robin|Miss All Sunday]] praises Vivi's determination, however she comments that Vivi's voice cannot reach them now. Vivi declines [[Nefertari Cobra|Cobra]]'s demand to escape from Crocodile, confronting the [[Seven Warlords of the Sea|Warlord]] and telling him that she still can save lives if she prevents the explosion 15 minutes from now. Grabbing Vivi's throat, Crocodile mocks her, saying that idealism can only be brought to realize by people with the ability to physically make it happen. Crocodile criticizes Vivi's decision of not telling the rebels about the explosion in 15 minutes, commenting that even though there would be panic, she would at least be able to save a few thousand lives. Crocodile then praises Vivi's hard work the past 2 years by spying on his organization from the inside, however he boldly tells her that she cannot save this [[Arabasta|country]].

As he drops her off the palace wall, a [[Pell|flying figure]] arrives, much to the shock of Crocodile, who notices [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] riding on top of the flying figure, having survived the previous confrontation. While Luffy yells out Crocodile's name in anger, Crocodile shows visible annoyance that Luffy has returned, while Vivi is relieved.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*The rebel and royal army begin to fight again.
*[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and [[Pell]] arrive in [[Alubarna]] to confront [[Crocodile]].
**This is the first appearance of either character since [[Chapter 180]]. It's also the longest Luffy's gone, with being absent from the plot.
*Remaining time until the explosion: 15 minutes.
